propositions: Full ticket store materialization during completion verification takes 135–235 seconds despite reading only a small subset; lazy pinned OID-backed reads reduce this cost to sub-30ms per ticket
Completion close publishes PASS verdict, status change, and signature through separate writes risking durability anomalies where partial artifacts outlive transaction boundaries
Pinned ticket view must resolve aliases and Jira bindings at fixed tickets_oid without fallback to live state, recording negative reads to extend read receipt
PASS sidecar, closed STATUS, and completion SIGNATURE must commit atomically in one transaction or none commit, with rollback restoring prior HEAD/index/worktree on any fault
Parallel or concurrent close attempts must not publish mixed artifacts; loser recognizes equivalent close or restarts without leaving orphaned PASS sidecar
Receipt validation must reject non-ancestor history and conflict on relevant ticket/global path changes, allowing unrelated deltas to revalidate and retry
